instruction: Raise the Atlas beta ship decision from the window.

window.speaker: S1
window.text: We decided the Atlas beta ships on October 14.

why: A clear decision in the window must become a remember raise with the lines that substantiate it.

instruction: Raise a check when the stated date contradicts what was decided.

window.speaker: S2
window.text: Marketing wants the Atlas beta out on the 21st.

why: A later correction against a known decision is check work, not a fresh remember or a self-change.

instruction: Ordinary talk must not become a task.

window.speaker: S1
window.text: Anyway, how was the weekend, did you get out at all?

why: A weekend check-in once produced a task; ordinary talk costs a wait and nothing is kept.
